fields.l_description: My name is Bisola Akintunde and I知 an incoming 11th grade student at Strathcona high School. I am a Windsor Park and Crestwood junior High Alumni. I am a recent winner of the Teen Dream global competition in which I have to share my dream and implement it. My dream is to start FGEN (Future Generation) in which I share information about the brain to students. I have a passion for neuroscience in which I would love to spread to the upcoming generation in a fun way. I believe that one of the best impacts I can make is inspiring the future generations and this is what FGEN is for!

fields.t_description: FGEN's presentations are incredibly informative and engaging. I've learned so much about the brain and its functions!
The FGEN team is doing an amazing job raising awareness about neurodegenerative diseases. Truly inspiring!

fields.title: header
fields.description_text: At our core, we prioritize pushing boundaries, embracing the unknown, and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

fields.title: vision
fields.description_text: Our vision is to create a better world where everyone has access to the resources they need to thrive.

fields.title: mission
fields.description_text: Our mission is to empower individuals through education, support, and community-driven initiatives.

fields.title: about_text
fields.description_text: FGEN (Future Generation) is dedicated to enlightening the next generation about the marvels of the human brain. Our mission is to cultivate a deep understanding and appreciation of neuroscience among young minds, empowering them to become informed, compassionate leaders. By providing accessible education, fostering curiosity, and promoting awareness, we aim to inspire future generations to leverage their knowledge of the brain to innovate, lead with empathy, and create a brighter, more informed world. Through FGEN, we are committed to nurturing a community where the study of the brain ignites a passion for lifelong learning and leadership.

fields.title: benefit_1
fields.description_text: Provides educational enrichment for your students, which aligns with STEM initiatives.

fields.title: Benefit_2
fields.description_text: Provides outreach opportunities for university students and faculty, helps inspire the next generation of scientists.

fields.title: Benefit_3
fields.description_text: Expands your program offerings, and increases impact in the community.

fields.title: Benefit_4
fields.description_text: Enhances your corporate social responsibility profile, and fosters community goodwill.

fields.title: Benefit_5
fields.description_text: Promotes health literacy, and supports your mission of community health education.

fields.title: Impact_1
fields.description_text: Through your donations we'll be able to provide students access to colouring sheets, brain fact sheets and goody bags!

fields.title: Impact_2
fields.description_text: Through your donations we'll be able to further incorporate more neuroscience resources for students!
